item.title: More winter warmth before storm chances Thursday

item.title: 'My daughter was somebody special'; Mother reacts to charges in 2022 shooting death
item.description: After several years of waiting, a break in the case of Mackenzie Lashley-Childers and Deundrea Woods' murder came when a Greene County Grand Jury indicted Walter Antwine Moore for both murders, as well as other charges, giving Jariee Lashley-Childers some answers and hope for justice.
